settings_ui_archive_hint: Capture archive preference only. Rust live capture is not connected; offline import retains its fixed 172 MiB archive / 156 MiB expanded safety limits. Findings filtering applies once rule results are available.
settings_ui_device_required: Choose a device and target in the title bar. Template, event probing, Period and scope adapters are not connected in Rust; they cannot be applied here.
settings_ui_engine_hint: Rust is the active engine. The Compose Legacy adapters are not linked into this independent app.
settings_ui_guide_body: 1. Select the target in the title bar.  2. Set duration and frequency.  3. Open CPU capture, inspect the plan, then explicitly confirm. Capturing is never started by changing a setting. Existing frozen plans and in-progress drafts are preserved.
settings_ui_hex_error: Use RGB, RRGGBB or AARRGGBB. The applied color was not changed.
settings_ui_sdk_error: The SDK must be an absolute directory with a usable platform-tools/adb executable.
settings_ui_sdk_hint: Choose an SDK directory containing an executable platform-tools/adb. Applies to future target discovery and captures; running operations keep their current ADB.
settings_ui_semantic_navigation_hint: Experimental. Launches a local language server (JDT LS, Kotlin LSP or clangd) for go-to-definition and find usages. Servers can use hundreds of MB of memory; source text never leaves this machine.
settings_ui_semantic_navigation_warning: Enable semantic navigation? A local language server process will be started and may use hundreds of MB of memory.
settings_ui_viewer_hint: Only the native Local viewer is connected. Firefox viewer adapters are not available in this app.
